segments.sn1.79:1.3: Kiṃsu naraṃ parikassati, kiṃsu lokasmi dujjahaṃ;
segments.sn1.79:1.5: Kismiṃ baddhā puthū sattā, pāsena sakuṇī yathā”ti.
segments.sn1.79:2.3: Icchā naraṃ parikassati, icchā lokasmi dujjahā;
segments.sn1.79:2.5: Icchābaddhā puthū sattā, pāsena sakuṇī yathā”ti.

lines: Navame saddhā bandhati pātheyyanti saddhaṃ uppādetvā dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ rakkhati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, tenetaṃ vuttaṃ.
Issariye hi abhimukhībhūte thalatopi jalatopi bhogā āgacchantiyeva.
Saddhā bandhati pātheyyanti saddhā nāma sattassa maraṇavasena mahāpathaṃ saṃvajato mahākantāraṃ paṭipajjato mahāviduggaṃ pakkhandato pātheyyapuṭaṃ bandhati sambalaṃ sajjeti.
Etaṃ vuttanti “saddhā bandhati pātheyyan”ti etaṃ gāthāpadaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā.
